transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Festival Sustainability Coordinator. Before we get into the details, I want to flag that I've got some concerns about the draft operating package — particularly the diesel generator and the mixed-waste bins from a sustainability standpoint. I'd like to hear from each of you on the electrical, permitting, transport, and accessibility sides before I make any approval decision. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a major electrical issue. During this week's technical test, I measured the planned sound and lighting load and confirmed that the park service can only supply 125 amps, while the draft package requires 200 amps. The good news is that a certified 180 kWh battery trailer is available and can support the full concert load — which would also address Mara's concern about the diesel generator — but I haven't yet added its load schedule to the operations packet. I'll need to get that done before approval.

transcript.text: I need to flag a permitting condition that isn't yet reflected in the sustainability checklist. Yesterday I confirmed with the city permit office that the event permit requires all serviceware to be compostable and requires three-stream waste stations for food and beverage areas. I haven't yet copied this condition into the festival's sustainability checklist, so the draft operating package's mixed-waste bins would not comply with the permit. We'll need to update the waste plan to three-stream stations before approval.

This morning I confirmed with the transit authority that the road-closure approval permits shuttle pickup only at the East Gate, with departures every 15 minutes from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The current transport sheet still shows the West Gate and 30-minute departures, so it needs to be updated before approval.

My accessibility inspection found that the accessible audience route must begin at the South Entrance and maintain a clear width of exactly 1.8 meters to the raised viewing platform. The current site map still routes guests from the main entrance and does not record the measured width, so it needs to be updated before approval.
